## Project Overview

As part of the RegenScore project through the UC Davis AIFS Fellowship, I
worked on improving how regenerative agriculture practices were collected and
organized.

The project focused on designing a more structured questionnaire that could
capture farming-practice information consistently while improving the
connection between agricultural producers and downstream stakeholders.

## Problem

Agricultural sustainability information can be difficult to compare when
responses are collected using inconsistent terminology or loosely structured
questions.

The goal was to create a questionnaire framework that produced more consistent,
usable data while reducing the burden of manual data collection.

## What I Built

The project included:

- Designing and refining questionnaire structures
- Organizing agricultural practice categories
- Improving consistency of collected responses
- Building structured Excel-based data collection workflows
- Developing an AI-assisted questionnaire concept
- Designing data structures for storing survey results
- Working with stakeholders to improve question clarity and usefulness

## Tools

**Excel · Data Collection Design · Database Design · AI-Assisted Workflows · Data Standardization**

## Impact

The redesigned workflow helped create a more consistent approach for capturing
regenerative farming practices and supported the development of structured
agricultural datasets.

The project also explored how AI-assisted questionnaires could make data
collection more scalable while maintaining a standardized structure.
